g.text: BIEU DO TUAN TU DA TANG (MULTI-TIER SEQUENCE DIAGRAM)
CHU TRINH BAN HANG & PHUC VU TAI BAN - TU MO BAN, IN BAR DEN THANH TOAN
Giai Doan 1: Mo Ban & Tao Don Hang Moi
Chon ban TRONG, chon mon & Bam "Mo ban / Tao don"
SELECT * FROM hoa_don WHERE ma_ban = 5 AND trang_thai IN ('DANG_PHUC_VU', 'CHO_THANH_TOAN')
UPDATE ban SET trang_thai = 'DANG_DUNG_NUOC' WHERE ma_ban = 5
INSERT INTO hoa_don (ma_ban, ma_nv, loai_don, trang_thai, thoi_gian_tao, phien_ban)
Cap nhat giao dien: Ban 5 chuyen sang mau DO (DANG_DUNG_NUOC)
Giai Doan 2: In Phieu Che Bien Cho Quay Bar
SELECT hd.*, cthd.* FROM hoa_don hd ... WHERE hd.ma_hoa_don = 45
HoaDon Entity (danh sach chi tiet mon)
UPDATE chi_tiet_hoa_don SET so_luong_da_in_bar = soLuong WHERE ma_cthd = ?
Tra ve du lieu phieu in Bar (mon uong, so luong moi, ghi chu)
Gui lenh in phieu ra may in Quay Bar (Web Print)
Giai Doan 3: Yeu Cau Thanh Toan & In Bill Tam Tinh
UPDATE hoa_don SET trang_thai='CHO_THANH_TOAN', thoi_gian_yeu_cau_tt=NOW() WHERE ma_hoa_don=45
UPDATE ban SET trang_thai='CHO_THANH_TOAN' WHERE ma_ban=5
Cap nhat giao dien: Ban 5 chuyen sang mau CAM (CHO_THANH_TOAN)
Du lieu bill tam tinh (tong_tien_goc, chiet_khau, tong_thanh_toan)
In phieu tam tinh dua phuc vu mang ra ban cho khach kiem tra
Giai Doan 4: Thu Ngan Xac Nhan Thanh Toan, Tru Kho & Dong Ban
Chon phuong thuc thanh toan, nhap tien & Bam "Xac nhan thanh toan"
Giam ton kho nguyen_lieu va them lich_su_kho (loaiGD='XUAT_BAN_HANG')
UPDATE hoa_don SET trang_thai='DA_THANH_TOAN' WHERE ma_hoa_don=45
UPDATE ban SET trang_thai='TRONG' WHERE ma_ban=5
Commit giao dich CSDL thanh cong
Xuat hoa don thanh toan chinh thuc
